title: Adaptation and Validation of a Short French Version of the Affective Style Questionnaire
authors: Makowski, D., Sperduti, M., Lavallée, S., Nicolas, S., & Piolino, P.
summary: A short French adaptation of the Affective Style Questionnaire, which measures the habitual ways people handle their own emotions — concealing them, adjusting them, or tolerating them — validated on a French-speaking sample.
